Container.Name: TriviaBix
Container.Overview: A Jackbox-style party trivia game. Put the host page on the TV, players answer on their phones. Open /host on the TV and /admin for the admin panel.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port for the TV, phone and admin pages.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The database (triviabix.db), the question packs (content/), Bix's voice lines and generated art (assets/, art/). Add your own packs under content/packs/mine.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address phones open and the QR code shows, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8080 (your server's LAN IP and the web port above).

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Turns on the admin panel at /admin. Leave empty to keep it off.

Config.Name: Music library
Config.Description: Optional. Your music share, the same folder Lidarr uses as its root folder. Mounted read-only; the TV streams Name That Tune clips and background music from it.

Config.Name: Lidarr URL
Config.Description: Optional. Lidarr's address, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8686. With the API key below, TriviaBix plays songs from your library.

Config.Name: Lidarr API key
Config.Description: Lidarr → Settings → General → Security → API Key.

Config.Name: Lidarr music path
Config.Description: The music folder as Lidarr sees it inside its own container, e.g. /music or /data/media/music. Leave empty to use Lidarr's root folder.

Config.Name: Library rating
Config.Description: Rating for library songs (PG, PG-13, MA or NC-17). Tracks Lidarr marks explicit are at least MA.

Config.Name: Content folder
Config.Description: Where question packs are read from. Inside /data so they live in appdata; the built-in packs are copied there on start.

Config.Name: Voice server
Config.Description: Optional. Address of the self-hosted Bix voice container (ghcr.io/piccologravel/triviabix-tts, needs an NVIDIA GPU), e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8000. Leave empty to use the browser's voice.

Config.Name: vast.ai API key
Config.Description: Optional. Can also be set on the admin panel's Settings page. Lets the Pipeline page rent a GPU on vast.ai for Bix's voice and cutscene art. Make one at https://cloud.vast.ai/manage-keys/ and keep a small prepaid credit (auto-reload off) as the spending limit.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional; can also be set on the admin panel's Settings page. Lets the Pipeline page have Claude write Bix's per-question lines. Billed to that Anthropic account (console.anthropic.com).

Config.Name: Hugging Face token
Config.Description: Optional. Passed to the art GPU for faster model downloads.

Config.Name: Private image login
Config.Description: Only if the triviabix-tts / triviabix-art packages on GHCR are private: -u PiccoloGravel -p (a read:packages token) ghcr.io

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the appdata files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the appdata files.
